source: Audited: KenGen audited results for the year ended 30 June 2026 (nse announcement, kegn_fy2026) and the audited financial statements FY2025, FY2024, FY2023 as printed (page-cited: Integrated Annual Report 2025 p136, Integrated Annual Report 2024 p140) | CRON 20261121: operating profit and operating expenses filled for FY2026, FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023. FY2026 and FY2025 come from the audited results announcement for the year ended 30 June 2026 (KenGen, 7 September 2026, condensed statement of profit or loss, KShs million): operating expenses 37,537 and 35,138 printed, operating profit 14,174 and 13,617 printed, against revenue 59,712 and 56,098, finance income 2,861 and 4,110, finance costs 1,982 and 2,254, profit before tax 15,053 and 15,473, profit after tax 10,353 and 10,481, all of which already matched this file. FY2024 and FY2023 operating profit is not printed in that announcement, so it is derived from the same statement structure, operating profit = profit before tax less finance income plus finance costs, an identity that reproduces the stored FY2022 operating profit of 6,079,807 exactly: FY2024 10,946,865 less 4,201,745 plus 2,805,920 equals 9,551,040; FY2023 8,524,816 less 1,688,805 plus 2,732,105 equals 9,568,116. Operating expenses for FY2024 and FY2023 are derived as gross profit less operating profit, the convention this file already used in its FY2022 column. Note that the filer's own operating expenses line excludes other income and the net foreign exchange and fair valuation line, which the statement adds above operating profit.
source_note: CRON 20261117: Revenue switched to TOTAL revenue as printed (the stored value was revenue less reimbursable expenses and did not agree with the same file own revenue detail rows). Cost of Sales added as the filed reimbursable expenses (fuel and water costs recovered through the fuel and water charges), Gross Profit as the filed subtotal Revenue less reimbursable expenses, and Operating Expenses corrected to the filed total of the detail rows: FY2025 was understated by 9,106m and FY2024 by 9,566m and FY2023 by 10,800m against the audited totals. Income Tax kept positive, the convention used across the stored set, so that Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit. FY2026 and FY2025 from the FY2026 audited announcement (KShs million as printed); FY2025 to FY2023 exact KShs thousands from the audited statements. FY2022 total revenue, reimbursable expenses and gross profit from the five year summary in the 2024 Integrated Annual Report (KShs million as printed); FY2022 operating expenses withheld because that filing summary does not print them. All amounts KES.
